front: When was the border through Berlin closed?
When was the Berlin Wall opened?

back: The loss of educated and skilled people who emigrate, as from East Germany before 1961.

front: How many people left East Germany between 1949 and 1961?
Why was the Berlin Wall built?
back: To stop East Germans, especially skilled workers, escaping to the West through West Berlin.

front: Why did Kennedy accept the Wall?
back: It did not touch Western rights in West Berlin, and removing it risked war.

front: What happened at Checkpoint Charlie in October 1961?
back: Soviet and American tanks faced each other before both withdrew.

front: Why was the Wall a propaganda gift to the West?
back: A state that had to wall in its own people seemed to admit communism lacked support.
